Title: Azure Lab Services—Virtual machine shutdown for Windows users

Body.Content:
Azure Lab Services added the ability to automatically shut down virtual machines (VMs) when a users’ remote desktop (RDP) session is disconnected. It’s possible to specify how long the virtual machines should wait for the user to reconnect before automatically shutting down. Currently, this feature is available only for Windows machines, and the Linux version is in development.

Learn more
